title: Dyson Clean+Wash £259, AirPods Pro 3 £165 and Ninja Crispi Pro £174.99
description: Monday's best UK deals: Dyson Clean+Wash Hygiene £259, AirPods Pro 3 £165, Dyson V8 £199.99 and Ninja Crispi Pro £174.99, all at Amazon.
intro:
**Today's standout is the Dyson Clean+Wash Hygiene wet floor cleaner at £259 on Amazon, which TechRadar calls its cheapest price by a distance, with the AirPods Pro 3 still at a record-low £165.** It's Black Friday week proper now: the day itself is this Friday (27 November) and Amazon's Black Friday Week runs to Cyber Monday (30 November). Our new spotlight, [Black Friday vacuum deals 2026](/spotlight/black-friday-vacuum-deals-2026/), covers which cordless and robot vacuums are worth buying now, and three of today's picks come from it.

Prices below were published on 22 November (TechRadar's UK and Amazon Black Friday live blogs) or read from PriceSpy on 23 November, so check the product page before you pay. Buy now or wait? On most of these, Friday is unlikely to beat what's on offer today, so if one is on your list, take it.

deals.name: Dyson Clean+Wash Hygiene wet floor cleaner
deals.note: Washes hard floors with clean water and sucks up the dirty water as it goes, so it replaces a mop and bucket. TechRadar says this is the cheapest it has ever been by a long way; Argos is a penny under £260 too.

deals.name: Dyson V8 cordless vacuum
deals.note: The cheapest way into a Dyson stick vacuum, and fine for flats and smaller homes. Which? puts its six-month low at £199, so this is as low as it goes. Check which tools are in the box.

deals.name: Dyson PencilWash wet floor cleaner
deals.note: A slimmer, lighter wet cleaner than the Clean+Wash, better for kitchens and bathrooms than whole houses. PriceSpy shows £179 at Amazon and AO today, the bottom of its price range.

deals.name: Ninja Crispi Pro glass air fryer
deals.note: The bigger version of the Crispi, with glass dishes that go from fryer to table to fridge. TechRadar says this is a record low. See our [air fryer Black Friday guide](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/) for other sizes.

deals.name: De'Longhi La Specialista Arte espresso machine
deals.note: A bean-to-cup-style espresso machine with a built-in grinder and steam wand, for people who want café coffee without a separate grinder. £200 off. Compare others in our [coffee machine guide](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Philips Sonicare 7100 electric toothbrush
deals.note: A good mid-range sonic brush with pressure warnings and a travel case. Ignore the £399.99 'was' price, which almost nobody pays; £139.99 is still a fair price. Our [Oral-B Black Friday guide](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/) has rival brushes.

deals.name: Apple AirPods Pro 3
deals.note: Apple's best earbuds, with strong noise cancelling and heart-rate tracking, at a new record low. More options in our [AirPods Black Friday guide](/guides/airpods-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Sennheiser IE 200 wired earphones
deals.note: Wired in-ears for people who care more about sound than features. TechRadar says this is a record low, and they make a thoughtful gift for a music fan.

deals.name: Amazon Ember 50-inch 4-Series 4K TV
deals.note: A simple 4K TV with Fire TV built in, ideal for a bedroom or second room. TechRadar calls it a record low. For bigger screens, see our [TV Black Friday guide](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/).

body:
## Worth waiting for?

Mostly no. The Dyson and Ninja prices above are at or near the lowest they've been, and Amazon has said its Black Friday Week prices run to 30 November, so there's no sign of a second, deeper round on Friday. The one exception is Shark's cordless range: the PowerDetect models are back up near full price at Amazon today, so if you want a Shark, wait and watch.

## This week's spotlight

Our new [Black Friday vacuum deals 2026](/spotlight/black-friday-vacuum-deals-2026/) spotlight covers Dyson, Shark and robot vacuums: which are at real lows, the prices worth paying and which 'was' prices to ignore. If you're still deciding between brands, [Shark vs Dyson cordless](/guides/shark-vs-dyson-cordless/) explains the difference.

Not a Prime member? Some Amazon prices need Prime, and a [free Prime trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) covers the whole of Black Friday Week. For everything else on this month, see [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).
